subject: Adding an alt tag to plots generated from renderPlot?

messages.author: b85bdfc1dfe47cbe
messages.subject: Adding an alt tag to plots generated from renderPlot?
parts:
Hi,

I am wondering if there is a way to add alt text to the plots generated from renderPlot?  I am creating a shiny app for a government website and it requires compliance with certain accessibility standards (Section 508).  One of the requirements is to have alt text for every image so that a screen reader could be used to access the site.  

I'd very much appreciate your help.

Best,

-Yong
